sources.title: Ortho2CAD: 3D CAD generation from orthographic drawings using vision ...
sources.snippet: The Qwen3VL-8B-Instruct training on DeepCAD dataset takes 11 hours on 4 $4$ H100 GPUs. For the CAD-Coder baseline (which is supervised finetuning of the LLaVA model), we use their recommended settings, and the training on our DeepCAD-derived orthographic drawing dataset paired with GenCAD-Code CadQuery codes also takes 11 hours on 4 $4$ H100 GPUs.

sources.title: Ortho2CAD: 3D CAD generation from orthographic drawings using vision ...
sources.snippet: To bridge this gap, we introduce Ortho2CAD, a vision-language model (VLM) specifically designed to translate rasterized orthographic drawings directly into editable CadQuery code, which can then be seamlessly converted into 3D CAD models.
